The '''Buichol Isthmus''' was a strip of crags that was at least 30 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in length and connected the islands of [[Lesser Piq Island|Lesser Peak]] and [[Greater Piq Island|Greater Piq]]. The wreckage of experimental vehicles created by the [[Cerise Fog Project]], an initiative by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]], was scattered along the isthmus after the initiative failed.<ref name="CatCW" />
